content: OCR extraction strategy: PDF.js first (for searchable PDFs, instant text extraction) → Tesseract.js OCR fallback (for scanned PDFs and images). Both client-side. Updated extractPDFText() in src/lib/ocr.js with onProgress callback to track page-by-page OCR progress.

OCR Test Lab page (src/pages/OCRTestPublic.jsx) updated to show extraction status messages and real-time progress during PDF.js + Tesseract.js processing. Public route at /#/ocr-test-public requires no authentication.

Fixed PDF.js worker loading: changed from CDN URL (cdnjs.cloudflare.com) to local bundled worker (pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.mjs?url) in src/lib/ocr.js. This prevents "Failed to fetch dynamically imported module" errors when extracting text from PDFs.

Fixed document delete error: Changed DocumentUploadForm.jsx to save documents with owner_id (not owner) field. The documents table policy is set to "owner" mode which requires owner_id field to match signed-in user ID for delete/update operations.

Updated DocumentAIAssistant.jsx: (1) Now uses pp.ai.generate() from PiPilot BaaS (server-side AI) instead of window.PiPilot.ai for better context handling; (2) Passes full extracted_text (up to 4000 chars) + document metadata as system prompt context; (3) Redesigned UI: fixed modal layout (centered, 85vh height, backdrop blur), fully responsive, better spacing and typography, large scrollable message area, improved visual hierarchy with accent colors.

PiPilot BaaS AI is fully functional—pp.ai.generate() runs in backend container without serverless function deployment needed. Use maxTokens (camelCase), system+messages pattern. __ai table policy=public/public. documents table uses owner_id field with owner-mode policy.
Document context extraction: PDF.js + Tesseract.js OCR both integrated. Up to 4000 chars extracted_text passed to AI. DocumentAIAssistant.jsx uses corrected maxTokens parameter.
PiPilot BaaS AI rate limits: 20 calls/min per user, 500/day free tier. Monitor console for 429 errors. Current live deployment: https://whimsy-maple-4ced.here.now/
DocumentChatPage.jsx created: full-page chat interface (not modal) with route #/chat/:documentId that extracts document ID from URL hash.
MarkdownMessage.jsx component renders markdown in AI responses: **bold**, `code`, ```code blocks```, bullet/numbered lists, [links](url).
Chat page includes spacious design (px-6 py-8), rounded message bubbles (rounded-2xl), shadows and borders; user messages blue (bg-primary), AI messages card style (bg-card).
Chat page features: document picker dropdown, quick action buttons (Summarize, Extract Info, Analyze, Classify), sticky bottom input bar, responsive layout.
Chat page AI integration: pp.ai.generate() with full document context (title, type, date, extracted_text); quick actions pre-populate input field.
